findings.location: T078-T079, especially T078 source-free request assertion
findings.evidence: T078 requires the source-free request to contain no tools, while the accepted strict-submission contract, T079, and the later T083 gate require that same request to carry exactly the two projected strict function declarations. Function declarations are tools in the Chat Completions request, so the paired RED and GREEN cannot simultaneously satisfy their stated contract without guessing that tools meant tool results or invocations.
findings.correction_outcome: Correct T078 to require exactly the two authorized strict function declarations while forbidding tool invocation/results, source, identities, job context, navigation evidence, prompt packets, and non-transport secrets. Keep the exact route/model/hash/stream assertions and preserve T079 as the distinct helper and T083 as the sole live-evidence gate.

findings.location: T070, T072, T074, T076, T078, T080, T082 and the T070+ dependency-order section
findings.affected_requirement: TDD taskability and deterministic execution ordering for FR-021, FR-054, FR-057-FR-064
findings.evidence: These tasks carry the SpecKit [P] marker even though the same section declares a strict T070 through T086 dependency chain. Some later RED tasks require types/composition created by earlier GREEN tasks, and T070 and T078 edit the same contract-qualification test file. A scheduler honoring [P] can therefore violate the stated dependency order or create overlapping test ownership.
findings.correction_outcome: Remove [P] from every T070-T086 task governed by the strict chain, or replace the full chain with explicit prerequisite-safe parallel groups and disjoint ownership. Preserve the mandatory sequential T082 fake-wire, T083 source-free live handshake, T084 isolated 3/3, T085 full T062, and T086 final barrier.

summary: REVISE.
